tools.name: search_stories_to_tell
tools.description: Search real charity stories a creator could make a video or post about. Matches the query against titles, summaries, charities, causes and places, and returns the best matches with a link to each story page.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Get one story in full: the story, where you could take it, the support on offer, and the charity's details.

tools.name: list_causes
tools.description: List the causes stories are filed under, with how many stories each has. Use a cause as the filter in a search.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "creators" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stories_to_tell · Public sink: search_stories_to_tell.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stories_to_tell · Public sink: search_stories_to_tell

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
